PLAY-1.name: NOT_AN_ITEM
PLAY-1.description: Said where the title named is not something the media server could hold.

PLAY-2.name: NOT_ON_THEIR_SHELF
PLAY-2.description: Said where the title is not one this member may watch, or is not there at all.

PLAY-3.name: NOT_A_DEVICE
PLAY-3.description: Said where what names a member's device is not a device id.

PLAY-4.name: NOTHING_TO_PLAY_FROM
PLAY-4.description: Said where there is no media server to play from, or it was never set up.

PLAY-5.name: SERVER_SILENT
PLAY-5.description: Said where the media server would not answer for a member.

PLAY-6.name: NOBODY_NAMED
PLAY-6.description: Said where nobody is named for something only a member can be.

PLAY-7.name: NOT_IN_THE_HOUSEHOLD
PLAY-7.description: Said where the member named is not somebody in the household.

PLAY-8.name: SIGNS_NO_DEVICE_IN
PLAY-8.description: Said where the media server will not sign a device in by code.

PLAY-9.name: NO_SUCH_PICTURE
PLAY-9.description: Said where a title on the member's shelf has no picture of the kind asked for.
